summary: The prepared main source already contains the ROCm correction from upstream PRs #34238 and #35195: eagle_sample broadcasts predict, accept_index, and num_correct_drafts from rank 0 in the HIP greedy branch. A new regression exercises that implementation with two logical TP ranks whose near-tied GPU logits produce different local argmax decisions; the fixed source makes all three decision tensors identical. Removing only the existing broadcast makes the synchronization regression fail.

tests.what_was_measured: On the prepared fixed source, three gfx950-backed tests passed: divergent logical TP decisions converge through the rank-0 broadcast, TP=1 performs no broadcast and retains its local result, and DP-attention selects attn_tp_group. Raw output: reports/j-a8b17ffbdd1c/restored-fixed-source.log

tests.command: same focused pytest command after temporarily removing only the existing HIP greedy broadcast block
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: the TP=2 logical-rank case performed zero broadcasts and the DP-attention group received zero broadcasts; two tests failed and the TP=1 boundary passed. The source block was restored immediately afterward. Raw output: reports/j-a8b17ffbdd1c/pre-fix-source.log

On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, GPU argmax results [1, 2] and [1, 1] for the two near-tied rank fixtures matched independent NumPy CPU references. Raw output: reports/j-a8b17ffbdd1c/gpu-argmax-evidence.log
The added regression test compiles successfully.

gpu_execution.evidence: The focused regression allocated logits and decision tensors on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU. The separate evidence log records the device, architecture, ROCm Torch build, NumPy references, and matching GPU argmax outputs.

remaining_limitations: Only one assigned GPU was available, so the test emulates two logical TP ranks and replays rank 0 broadcast values; it does not claim a real TP=2 collective or deadlock reproduction.
No production EAGLE/GLM model weights or draft model were available, so full serving, semantic accuracy, and the reported --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion workload were not reproduced.
The implementation fix predates this checkout and was not rewritten; this PR adds the previously missing regression coverage and evidence.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
